items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: And Herschel Evans and Hersch Levins was there. Buck Clayton. Walter Page -- The drummer, [with] Woody Herman -- Dave Tough. Joe Jones. All these kind of people used to come down every night

ctx.x: Benny Goodman and Lester Young had a battle of music that we played 'Honeysuckle Rose' for 45 minutes and in the interchange Lester played his clarinet and Benny played his tenor and the music hadn't been going for 45 minutes at that particular time. That was fantastic.

And Herschel Evans and Hersch Levins was there. Buck Clayton. Walter Page -- The drummer, [with] Woody Herman -- Dave Tough. Joe Jones. All these kind of people used to come down every night and they had a big furnace downstairs, we'd go downstairs and turn on, learn how to smoke pot. But it was fantastic but from seven to four, seven nights a week.
How long were the sets usually. When you didn't have someone sitting in in that situation where it might -- like 45 minutes sets and 15 off.
